topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The sun dips low, casting long shadows across the clearing. I move through the underbrush, each step deliberate. The scent of the earth mingles with the sweetness I carry in my jaws. A bundle, carefully gathered—vibrant hues of nature’s palette. I set it down at the edge of her den, the place she calls home. She will know. She will understand the silent message, the unspoken words woven into the petals and leaves. It is enough. My offerings speak of the care that threads itself through the weave of our days, the quiet strength in the bond that binds us. Tonight, the forest whispers a little softer, the night a little warmer.
